title: Switch Active Xcode Version
summary: Change which Xcode application or developer directory is used by the command-line tools. This is useful if you have multiple versions of Xcode installed.

steps.explain: Set the active developer directory to a specific Xcode application or path. You need to know the full path to the Xcode app or the developer directory.

placeholders.name: XCODE_PATH
placeholders.description: Full path to the Xcode application (e.g., /Applications/Xcode.app) or the developer directory (e.g., /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer).

rollback.explain: Reset the developer directory to the default search mechanism, discarding any custom path.

warnings: This command requires administrator privileges if you use the reset option.
Ensure the path you provide is correct, otherwise command-line tools may stop working.
